open_questions: Comparative task success, cost and adoption have not been independently measured in this study; a controlled trial remains future work.
recommended_next_direction: Refresh affected official contracts and pinned snapshots before mutable comparisons; add studies only when a clear design question and evidence justify them.

output.audience: Curious technical readers, builders and authors learning agent mechanisms and implementation choices.

validation.method: npm run validate: 48 deployment tests, 135 content tests, Astro 0 errors/warnings/hints, 84-page build and docs lint.

rendering.method: Five current overview views: 1440/light+dark, 768/light, 390/light, 320/dark; two Focus views; manual screenshot review; all unique linked routes/anchors, keyboard navigation, reduced motion and no-JS checked.

exports.method: Current overview Markdown/MDX: complete intent, harness, four loop steps, feedback, capabilities, controls, role definitions, all example/frontier links, caveat, figure anchor, caption and five references; no raw map JSON in Markdown.
